objective: G18 with G5. Freeze one rule: a knot that owes more payments than it has loose distinctions pays the rest with shared ones, so a round never stalls for that reason. Class it on extension of old words, the recorded sources, the starts that stall under ordinary growth, the holders it makes, the stalling tables and the pace of influence. Stop when each is classed.
title: A growth law in which a short knot pays with a shared distinction
